results.title: 'Padmaavat' writer Prakash Kapadia backs Jauhar scene; says ‘reality of those times’ cannot be changed; reacts to Swara Bhasker's criticism
results.description: Padmaavat co-writer Prakash Kapadia defended the film's Jauhar sequence. He stated the depiction reflected historical realities and research from that period. Kapadia mentioned that viewers interpret films based on their own perspectives and intentions. He also noted that the practice of Kesariya involved male warriors preparing for certain death. The film faced significant controversy and protests before its eventual release.
